newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian banks seek more guarantees for creditors.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian banks seek more guarantees for creditors.

text.p: Bulgaria's Association of Commercial Banks is urging the government to provide more effective legal protection for creditors against bad debtors, Association board chairman Ognian Enchev said.
Enchev met Prime Minister Ivan Kostov on Wednesday and told reporters he had urged the government to amend the law to offer creditors greater protection.

Lack of financial discipline in Bulgaria's banks and legal loopholes that benefited bad debtors contributed to a severe banking crisis last year, prompting the central bank to seek insolvency for 17 banks.
Bankers suggested that the government amend legislation to permit banks to collect debts more effectively through speedier court rulings, he said.

Banks were still reluctant to make loans despite their relatively high liquidity, the introduction of a currency board exchange rate system and the financial stabilisation of the past months because of the lack of satisfactory legal protection against bad debtors, Enchev said.
"Banks still think that the economic environment is risky and the legislation puts debtors in a more favourable position compared to creditors," he added.

Legal amendments providing greater protection to creditors were expected to be approved by the government at the year-end and passed to parliament at the beginning of 1998, the government press centre said.
Due to the falling yield on government securities in the past month and the underdeveloped local stock market banks have few alternatives for investing funds, bankers said.

The central bank main interest rate, which is adjusted to yield on government securities, has been falling since July 1 when Bulgaria introduced the currency board fixed exchange rate mechanism to boost confidence in its lev currency.

The central bank main lev rate now stands at 6.12 percent annually. Local banks now extend short-term loans at around 7.5 points over the central bank main rate and interest on long-term loans stands around 4.5 points over the main rate. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 981 4145
